summary: Injured paraglider hoist-rescued from a steep gully on Red Mountain above Glenwood Springs
responding_agency: Garfield County SAR + CO Army National Guard HAATS UH-60 Black Hawk hoist crew
notes: Paraglider crashed into a steep 60-degree rock-strewn gully more than 1,000 ft up Red Mountain; site unsafe for ground rescuers, so the Guard helicopter hoist-lifted the injured pilot ~150 ft (DVIDS B-roll, date taken 2013-08-21; video by Garfield County SAR). Garfield County's first indexed 2013 row. Run 544 DVIDS merge (URL opened this run): alternate DVIDS video asset of the Red Mountain paraglider hoist (video/299431 already on row); confirms HAATS UH-60 ~150-ft hoist from a steep 60-degree rock-strewn gully.
